prompts.text: The cracked bell remembers Bin's shadow, but only Mitia hears the second ring.
The hungry lantern follows the party, but wolves refuse to cross its light.
The blue-lit mushroom mocks the nearest adventurer, but Corvin already filed paperwork about it.
The old crossbow bolt warms in Bowy's hand, but Garr refuses to explain who carved it.
prompts.suggestedUse: Bowy side quest or Garr clue.

prompts.text: The wolf-marked guild stamp freezes every form it touches, but Lysa insists this happens only sometimes.
The silent pelt stains the snow blue, but the Frosted Mug cook wants to buy it anyway.
The warm shrine refuses the offering, but Peri gives the attempt a five-star rating.
The half-buried debt follows Bin through town, but the Brinna Twins have itemized the interest.

entries.notes: No runtime AI required. Roll a prompt, then GM chooses whether it stays a note, saved idea, or review item.
